name: Anna Robinson-Barella
role: Lecturer in Clinical Pharmacy and Health- and Medicines- Inequality
researchKeywords: medicines inequalities, health inequalities, minoritised communities, marginalised communities
bio: Anna Robinson-Barella is a Lecturer in Clinical Pharmacy and Health and Medicines Inequality at Newcastle School of Pharmacy. She is also a Specialist Clinical Pharmacist with experience across primary and secondary care in North East England.
researchFocus: Anna works with people from minoritised and marginalised communities. Her research seeks to address inequalities in medicines and health.

professionalRoles.title: Director for Equality, Diversity and Inclusion
